products.title: BLUE MOON SMD ROUND
products.body_html:
Description

ORIENT Lighting, SMD, Downlight provides silky Smooth bright light with a long life and significant energy savings up to 80%. With a smart and elegant design made with Aluminum for a wide useability with good heat sink for long life replacing out Old incandescent bulbs and fixtures

  • High color rendering 75CRI for vivid colors

The color rendering index (CRI) is used to describe the effect of a light source on color appearance. Natural outdoor light has a CRI of 100 and is used as the standard of comparison for any other light source. The CRI of Orient Lighting LED (Category) light bulbs is always higher than 75CRI close to the sun's value, reflecting colors truly and naturally.

  • Designed for the comfort of your eyes

It's easy to see how harsh lighting can strain the eyes. Too bright, and you get the glare. Too soft and you experience flicker. Now you can gently light up your world with LEDs designed to go easy on the eyes, and create the perfect ambience for your home.

  • Instant light when switched on

No need to wait: Orient led Lighting Downlight (provide their full level of brightness immediately upon switching on.

  • Lasts up to 8 years

With a lifetime of up to 18.000 hours (10 Hrs./day), this Orient Lighting LED Downlight will ensure your desired atmosphere for up to 8 years. *

  • Safe for any room and convenient to recycle

Orient Lighting LED Downlight contain absolutely no hazardous materials, making them safe for any room and convenient to recycle.

  • Beautiful, switched on and off

Light can have different color temperatures, indicated in units called Kelvin (K). Bulbs with a low value produce a warm, more cozy light, while those with a high Kelvin value, create a cool, more energizing light.

  • Avoid the hassle of changing Lights

The durable alternative to incandescent light bulbs, Orient Lighting LED Downlight can be installed and forgotten about, maintaining their beautiful light beam for years and years to come.

Applications

  • Home
  • Office
  • Malls
  • Hospitality
  • Commercial Area
  • Shops
  • Other General Use

products.title: Anti-Glare Adjustable LED Spot Light
products.body_html:
Anti-Glare Adjustable LED Spot Light (Recessed Downlight)

Enhance your interiors with this premium Anti-Glare Adjustable LED Spot Light, designed to deliver focused illumination with maximum visual comfort. Featuring a deep-recessed light source and precision reflector, this spotlight minimizes glare while providing clean, controlled light—ideal for modern residential and commercial spaces.

Its tiltable adjustable design allows you to direct light exactly where it’s needed, making it perfect for accent lighting, highlighting décor, retail displays, artwork, or architectural details. The sleek white finish blends seamlessly into ceilings, offering a refined and minimalist appearance.

Built with high-quality materials and efficient LED technology, this spotlight ensures long life, low power consumption, and consistent performance.

Key Features:

  • Anti-glare deep recessed design for comfortable lighting

  • Adjustable/tiltable head for directional illumination

  • Modern, clean white finish

  • Energy-efficient LED technology

  • Long lifespan with low maintenance

  • Easy recessed ceiling installation

Applications:

  • Homes & apartments

  • Retail stores & showrooms

  • Offices & commercial spaces

  • Hotels, galleries & restaurants

A perfect combination of style, performance, and visual comfort, this anti-glare spot light is an excellent choice for any space that demands precise and elegant lighting.
